## Natural history notes

A medium-sized band-winged grasshopper characterized by brown to gray mottled body coloration and yellow hindwings that flash during flight. In Florida, it is found in dry open habitats such as sandhills, scrub, pine flatwoods, prairies, roadsides, and other sandy or sparsely vegetated areas where bare ground and grasses are available. It feeds mainly on grasses and other low plants, usually resting camouflaged on the ground and making short, noisy flights when disturbed.
